title: Yu-Wang-Samworth 2015: population-gap eigenspace and singular-subspace perturbation bounds
summary: A machine-checked Lean 4 formalization of the principal population-gap perturbation results of Yi Yu, Tengyao Wang and Richard J. Samworth, "A useful variant of the Davis-Kahan theorem for statisticians" (Biometrika 102 (2015) 315-323). This single Palomar entry compares both conclusions of Theorem 2 and both displays of Corollary 1 for eigenspaces of real symmetric matrices, together with the right- and left-singular-subspace conclusions of Theorem 3 for general real matrices and two supporting equivalences between its Gram-eigenvector formulation and the paper's paired singular-vector…
